newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia to set up legislation for factoring firms.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia to set up legislation for factoring firms.

text.p: Tunisia is preparing a legislation to authorise the setting up of factoring firms as part of efforts to modernise the financial sector, Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali said on Saturday.
"We order today the elaboration of a legislation for setting up factoring firms," Ben Ali said in a speech at parliament.
"These services will help ease the administrative and judicial proceedings burden put on the firms and particularly on the banks," he added.
